constructor: Actual common_root()['cliff'] supplies C0=Xmirror tensor I2 and Ci=Ymirror tensor Fi, with Fi the actual Pauli/quaternion-frame matrices. A single colourless four-component block is used at each of 27 sites. These ordered matrices are an explicit conditional ansatz, not imported free-Dirac gamma matrices labelled a substrate derivation.
space: Periodic 3x3x3 cells, lattice spacing 1, volume 27, 108 CAR modes. Reference h(phi_center,A=0) is diagonalized anew; its 54 negative eigenmodes are actually occupied in the reference determinant. The same orbital transformation is retained at ALL quantum field nodes, so this is diabatic Slater dynamics, not a frozen classical field or an instantaneous ground-state surface.

law.fermion: h(phi,A)=g phi C0 + 3r C0 + sum_(x,i) [|x><x+ei| tensor (-iv Ci/2-r C0/2) exp(i e Ai(z)) + h.c.]. H_F=dGamma(h). Wilson regulator r and ordered scalar phase are declared inputs; no bare lepton mass independent of phi is added.
law.field: A_x(z)=Q_xc cos(qz)+Q_xs sin(qz), A_y(z)=Q_yc cos(qz)+Q_ys sin(qz), A_z=0, q=2pi/3. Both transverse polarizations share the SAME q; sin/cos partners permit travelling phase structure. This single q is NOT a localized field packet.
law.electric: H_E=sum_a P_a^2/(2 I_a), I_a=V/2 from sum_x cos^2(qz)=sum_x sin^2(qz)=V/2. NO bare B^2, transverse Q^2 restoring potential or supplied transverse oscillator.
law.order: H_phi=P_phi^2/(2 V scalar_inertia)+V scalar_stiffness (phi-phi_center)^2/2. This is a supplied ordered scalar potential, with quantum amplitude fluctuations; full frame/matrix/bundle fluctuations and spontaneous ordering are not derived.
law.longitudinal: Selected conditional transverse law sets nonuniform longitudinal Coulomb interaction to ZERO. A uniform ionic background labels sea neutrality; there is no full Gauss-law Maxwell completion or source-ion longitudinal join claim.
law.reference_offset: The fixed sea energy of h(phi_center,0) is subtracted as ONE sector-independent constant. It is not a field-dependent normal-order subtraction: the occupied sea remains a dynamical supplier at every Q and phi.
law.physical_current: J_a=-partial H/partial Q_a, with actual edge Peierls derivative including charge e and cos/sin spatial profiles. Contact K_aa=partial^2 H/partial Q_a^2. All current, contact and quantum field reaction use this SAME H; no separate response kernel or pasted supplier state. J_a is a physical transverse Fourier current, not a total coordinate velocity or Noether spin.

quantum_representation.bosons: Tensor collocation/DVR of phi,Q_xc,Q_xs,Q_yc,Q_ys. Electric kinetic is the exact finite periodic Fourier P^2 matrix on each selected box; multiplication coordinates and Peierls coupling are evaluated on nodes. Canonical commutator/boundary discontinuities and low field cut are explicit finite-regulator errors, not ignored continuum identities. Field-only exp(i kappa Q_xc) is exactly diagonal/unitary in this entire tensor space.
quantum_representation.fermions: Fixed orthonormal one-particle orbitals give exact Slater determinants with 54,55,53 fermions. Reference sea plus current/H-connected single excitations and selected compatible double excitations are used for N=54. N=55 and N=53 retain ALL 54 elementary addition/removal determinants plus source-relevant current/pair configurations. Full CAR signs come from actual 108-bit creation/annihilation operations, not empty-band/hole species copies.
quantum_representation.selection: Rank is selected by actual field-weighted h_cv and J_cv matrix-element strengths. These are nonadiabatic diabatic configurations; compatible pairs of selected excitations add explicit two-pair directions. Low-rank control changes this retained physics. The projection is NOT exact all-pair closure.
quantum_representation.matrix_elements: Every one-body matrix is evaluated by exact Slater-Condon rules with full CAR parity. The overlap Gram is exactly identity in this orthonormal determinant representation, explicitly retained with unit eigenvalues and identity whitener. No nonorthogonal eigenvector is interpreted as a probability.
quantum_representation.error: For the neutral ground, enumerate every omitted determinant reached by the actual original one-body H; sum all configuration amplitudes coherently per field node and measure norm((1-P)H psi). This is the exact omitted fermionic H action at the SELECTED field grid (up to stated coefficient screening), not a rigorous gap bound or bosonic cutoff bound. Source CAR norm is independently measured, with retained and omitted creation/removal weights.
quantum_representation.sources: Creation/removal use the SAME normalized physical real-space spinor packet f transformed to the 108 orbitals, actual cdagger(f) and c(f), SAME neutral quantum ground, and SAME boson family. Raw norms sum to 1. Source-state projection loss is disclosed before normalizing the chosen charged preparation; field-only phase kick thereafter has no projection, no lost norm and no conditioning.

consumers.motion: Evolve the actual charged source packet with complete projected quantum H. Site density n_x includes all orbital coherences, including cross-kx/ky blocks, so x,y,z packet motion is not discarded by a translational symmetry-sector measurement. Excess density is n_x minus the untouched neutral ground density; total excess is one.
consumers.reaction: Baseline and exp(i kappa Q_xc)-kicked copies share EXACTLY the same initial charged state before the independent field unitary. The kick commutes with every matter density and Q-diagonal physical current, so t0 body observations are unchanged. Later charge/current/order and field-distribution differences measure the coupled quantum reaction. Field reduced purity measures matter-field entanglement within the chosen variational space.
consumers.contrast: Freeze only h(phi,Q) coefficients at phi_center,Q=0 while retaining full quantum boson kinetic and EXACT same two prepared states. This removes dynamic feedback, not negative sea occupation. Current entries in that control are labelled original-law diagnostic operators, not frozen-H physical currents.
consumers.spectral: Reorthogonalized finite Lanczos quadrature acts on SAME projected H, retaining original unnormalized source/current/field vectors. G_R(z)=sum_r Zplus_r/(z-(Eplus_r-E0))+sum_s Zminus_s/(z+(Eminus_s-E0)); removal denominator sign is positive. D_R and current commutator use sum_r w_r[(z-omega_r)^-1-(z+omega_r)^-1]. Both frequency signs and contact means are retained; finite Krylov quadrature is not exact full-Fock spectral closure.
